issues.detail: Taxonomy §1.2总览表规定Project Category为Single-select by default，§2.3规定Multi-select。不自行选择公司政策，selection_type=null；交Admin确认后才能作为可靠选择规则使用。
后附正式Language清单存在完全相同值重复：pashto原始出现2次；uzbek原始出现2次。快照仅按(tag_group, tag_value)去重，保留全部正式清单sources；未计入前面的Naming Examples。
farsi与persian可能等价，但正式文档同时列出；两者原样保留，交Admin核验，不自动合并。不把chinese/mandarin/cantonese或其他相关但不同的语言擅自合并；可能等价判断并非已经确认的库变更。
跨组同值：model fine-tuning出现在project category和knowledge domain。Tag Groups独立；身份键为(tag_group, tag_value)，不做全局去重，不视为组内重复。
上传文档标示1.0只证明文档版本，不证明其为当前批准库。管理规范要求Active/Inactive状态及唯一current approved version，但未给逐标签状态或当前批准版本验证证据。current_approved_version_verified=false、active_status_verified=false；全部标签status=null，不转换为Active。
两份上传文档未提供逐标签Moka ID或映射表，管理规范Export字段也没有Moka ID。不能以文本、序号或自造ID冒充Moka ID；moka_id_mapping_verified=false，全部moka_tag_id=null。

Tag Group: project category
Selection Type: Multi-select
Requirement: Required
Project Category represents the type of business work or project activity that a candidate can support.
The following categories constitute the approved Project Category Tag Library for v1.0.
E-commerce Moderation is included within Content Moderation as a core business category.
This category is intentionally limited to Audio and Speech Data Collection.
This category covers AI-related speech and audio work, including ASR and TTS.
This category covers traditional BPO Customer Service business activities. Further subcategories are not required in v1.0.
This category covers talent and project activities related to Robotic and Embodied AI.
Egocentric Video Collection and Robotic Data Collection are intentionally classified under this category rather than the general Data Collection category.
This category represents the company's Location Based Service business line and is retained regardless of current talent pool coverage.

Tag Group: knowledge domain
Selection Type: Multi-select
Requirement: Optional
Knowledge Domain represents a candidate's professional knowledge, subject-matter expertise or relevant technical knowledge.
The following section headings are organizational groupings only. The actual Tag Library remains flat.
